metadata.scenario: An event planner urgently requests additional staffing for an upcoming event due to unforeseen demand. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Harold Gonzalez. I hope you’re doing well. I'm doing great, thank you! How can I help you today? Well, I'm actually calling because I need urgent help for an event this weekend. We've had a surge in attendees. I see, an urgent request. Can you tell me how many caregivers you need? We need at least three personal care assistants for the event to help with various tasks. Okay, let me check our availability for you. We typically charge between $28 to $35 per hour for personal care assistance. Does that work for your budget? Yes, that’s fine. We just need to make sure they can handle unexpected situations. Absolutely. We can brief them on your needs before the event. Thank you! I’d like them to arrive at least an hour before the event starts. What time does the event start? It starts at 2 PM, so they should be there by 1 PM. Great, I’ll note that down. Just to confirm, we’ll need three personal care assistants from 1 PM to the end of the event. Yes, that’s correct. I’ll also need your email to send over the details and confirm staffing. Sure, it’s harold.gonzalez@email.com. Thank you, Harold. I’ll send over the confirmation right away. I really appreciate the quick help. Is there any possibility of a nurse being available, just in case? Let me check on that for you. We do have a registered nurse available for that day. Their rate is between $95 and $125 for skilled nursing care. That sounds good. Can you include that in the email? Absolutely, I’ll add that option. Is there anything else you need while I have you on the line? No, that's all for now. Thank you so much for your help! You’re welcome, Harold! I’ll follow up with the email shortly. Great, I look forward to it. Have a good day! You too, take care!
